The Incident Between Hadhrat Sa'd (RA), Hadhrat Usaama (RA) and another Person About not Fighting

Hadhrat Ibraheem Taymi reports from his father that after eating a full meal, Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) said, "I shall never fight anyone who recites 'Laa Ilaaha Illallaah'." Hadhrat Sa'd bin Maalik (bin Abi Waqqaas) (RA) then remarked, "By Allaah! I shall also never fight a man who recites 'Laa Ilaaha Illallaah'." Another man then said to the two of them, "Does Allaah not say:

blocks.arabic_text: وَقٰتِلُوْهُمْ حَتّٰى لَا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّيَكُوْنَ الدِّيْنُ كُلُّهٗ لِلّٰهِ
blocks.text: Fight them until no corruption (kufr and shirk) exists and all religion (worship) is for Allaah.
The two Sahabah (RA) replied, "We did fight until no corruption existed and until all religion was for Allaah."[^2]
Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) Restrains Himself from Fighting During the Troubled times of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA)

Hadhrat Naafi reports that two men approached Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) during the period of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Zubayr (RA) when fighting was raging. They asked, "People are dying while you are the son of Umar (RA) and a companion of Rasulullaah ﷺ? What prevents you from going out (and fighting)?" Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "What prevents me is that Allaah has made the blood of my brother Haraam (for me to spill)." They argued, "Does Allaah not say:

blocks.arabic_text: وَقٰتِلُوْهُمْ حَتّٰى لَا تَكُوْنَ فِتْنَةٌ وَّيَكُوْنَ الدِّيْنُ كُلُّهٗ لِلّٰهِ
blocks.text: 'Fight them until no corruption exists and all religion (worship) is for Allaah.'?"

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) replied, "We did fight until no corruption existed and until all religion was for Allaah. However, you people are fighting so that corruption should appear and so that religion should be for others besides Allaah.[^3]

Another narration states that a man approached Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and said, "O Abu Abdur Rahmaan! What makes you perform Hajj one year, Umrah the following year but leaving out waging Jihaad in the path of Allaah whereas you know what encouragement Allaah has given for it?"
